reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 0 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Magic win 54 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.

analyst.text: Orlando have won four straight, including their first win in Boston since 2022, and Jalen Suggs is back from an eight-game knee absence, though Paolo Banchero is still out. Philadelphia are 12-3 and top of the East, but Joel Embiid (plantar fascia) and LeBron James (back) are both on careful management plans. The angle leans slightly towards Orlando, with Embiid's availability the swing factor.
